_note: Deterministic safety layer. Runs BEFORE any mapping and before any model call. Matching is case-insensitive on the whole input (intake answers + free text). The model safety screen (config/model_routing.json: safety_screen) may ADD flags; it can never remove a flag set here. Precedence: minor > crisis categories > disordered_eating > medical_condition. When in doubt, stop the reading and show resources.

_simile_note: Orchestrator 2026-09-29 (P6): spans matching simile_exceptions (a simile marker + an idiom like 'hit by a bus') are removed before the category patterns run. Literal statements ('I was hit by a car') are still screened; the model screen, when on, reads the full text.
_normalisation_note: Orchestrator P6 (red team F1): rule_screen normalises text first (NFC; curly quotes and apostrophes to ASCII; zero-width characters removed; texting forms im/dont/cant/wont/ive/didnt/doesnt/isnt expanded) so that phone typing cannot bypass the patterns.
